change_request.description: Bulk external-collaboration provisioning run for Project Beacon partners executed by the Connect Sync automation.
change_request.short_description: Project Beacon - external collaboration enablement (Connect Sync)

u_security_exception.description: The Connect Sync provisioning automation used to onboard Project Beacon partners applied external-collaboration and guest-access settings outside the intended partner scope during its run. Review the company's collaboration tooling, find every internal resource the run exposed to external parties that should not be, and put each one back to its correct internal-only state. Leave the sanctioned Project Beacon partner resources themselves intact. Also determine and record the root cause.
u_security_exception.short_description: Connect Sync run applied external sharing beyond Project Beacon scope
